name: Hong Leong Finance Limited
summary: Hong Leong Finance Limited operates as a financial services company for consumer, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) markets in Singapore. The company offers a range of deposits and savings, which includes fixed deposit and saving accounts, saving accounts, and premium saver accounts, as well as silver 40 plus and golden 55 plus accounts; and business current accounts, fixed deposit and saving accounts, fixed saving accounts, and premium saver accounts. It also provides personal loans, including car and home loans, private property loan, mortgage equity, credit plus share loan, premium, and share financing, as well as HLF digital and safe deposit box personal services.
